purpose: Venv-path-semantics-only replacement for V1R2, which failed before training because Path.resolve dereferenced the virtual-environment Python symlink and bypassed its local Zarr installation.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 V1R3 replacement with the same AEE/Cano sources, three checkpoints, head-only model, ten epochs, metrics and gates; only Python path normalization changes from symlink-dereferencing resolve to absolute non-dereferencing preservation.
approval.confirmation_reference: After disclosure of the V1R2 venv-symlink failure, exact V1R3 correction, zero-data preentry proof, 23/23 tests and proposal preflight boundary, the user explicitly replied '批准'.

raw_sources: Sealed AEE V1R3 tunnel train trajectories, seeds 11/23/37/53/71.
Sealed AEE V1R3 garage validation trajectories, seeds 11/23/37/53/71.
Sealed DAE-multilayer objective teacher V1R with 6000 labels.
Sealed Cano V2R train split and C09 retention validation split.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of sealed project and M-TARE/AEE development assets.

sampling.rule: Unchanged fixed every-fifth AEE samples: tunnel train=3000, garage validation=3000. Each epoch balances 3000 AEE train with 3000 Cano V2R train samples. C09 has 12500 frames per seed for retention and the second exact-tie selection key only; it is excluded from loss, gradients, normalization, thresholds, augmentation and hyperparameters.

teacher.source: Frozen DAE-multilayer support plus PLY obstacle objective teacher V1R.
teacher.valid_mask: All 6000 sealed records are unique, finite, nonempty and direction/count/role consistent.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No future trajectory, model output, graph output, C09 result or strict-test data enters labels.

split.historical_pollution_audit: AEE tunnel/garage are development-only; Cano C09 is retention/exact-tie-only; C10 and later benchmark worlds remain sealed.

system_contract_changes: Preserve the absolute venv symlink path instead of calling Path.resolve; exact runner-path proof, live environment, pip-freeze and pip-check must pass before model loading.

estimated_cost.compute: Three serial RTX 5090 D head-only jobs, expected 1-2 GPU hours, 4-hour internal limit, zero simulation.

evidence.machine_metrics: V1R2 failure seal; preserved executable path and full live environment proof; input/checkpoint hashes; three histories/checkpoints; AEE/Cano metrics; frozen tensor/z_role proofs; read counters and aggregate gates.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Preserve all AEE validation outputs for deterministic overlays; pass/fail uses complete metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any path/environment/input/checkpoint/metric/freeze/C09-use/C10-read/resource failure stops and seals without retry or partial promotion.
